sessions.name: Wine expert — canonical sample
sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 3. 22 findings in findings/findings_wine_canonical.md: 9 P0, 8 P1, 4 P2, 1 P3. Stratified 99-wine + 50-producer sample audited inline by Opus 4.6 (pivoted from Sonnet API — $0 actual vs $18 pre-auth). Headline: (F1) 8/10 marquee wines broken (Vega Sicilia missing, DRC/Lafite wrong color, Opus One/Dom Pérignon/Screaming Eagle NULL display_name, Grange matched to 'by Nigo' limited edition, Hill of Grace matched to Museum Release); (F2) Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc grape bug is systemic — 2,743 of 2,809 Chardonnay-named wines (97.6%) have Pinot Blanc linked; (F3) all 15 famous producers have 0 metadata (DRC, Lafite, Latour, Margaux, Haut-Brion, Pétrus, Gaja, etc. — website/year/coords all NULL); (F4) Domaine Leroy tagged region=Beaujolais; (F5) Catena/Alta Vista producer collision; (F7) invented grape GARRO on Messina Hof (actual grape is Lenoir/Black Spanish, primary-source verified); (F10) AI content confabulates narratives when data is wrong — Joseph Phelps Eisele ai_summary claims Phelps bought Eisele in 2013 (actual: Artemis/Latour, primary-source verified); (F14) geology fabrication (Hunter Valley 'volcanic', Santa Ynez 'Franciscan shale'); (F19) Bruno Clair CCdB textbook classification error. 3 primary-source WebFetch verifications, all confirmed Loam wrong. Top Sprint 3 sequence: (a) S2.2 F1 staging relink → (b) S2.3 F3 producer seed → (c) F2/F7/F8 grape repair → (d) F6 color repair → (e) F10 L3 re-fact-check → (f) content regeneration.

sessions.name: Wine expert — reference content
sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 4. 30 findings in findings/findings_wine_reference.md: 8 P0, 14 P1, 7 P2, 1 P3. Opus inline + 1 WebFetch verification, $0 actual vs $0 planned. Headline: (F1) varietal_categories has confirmed wrong-grape links on Merlot→Grolleau Noir, Riesling→Crouchen, Verdejo→Trousseau Noir, Greco→Albana Bianca, St. Laurent→Muscat St. Laurent — 5+ P0 errors in 161-row categorization table. (F2) Root cause of S2.3 F2 (Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc bug) identified: PINOT BLANC has VIVC synonyms PINOT CHARDONNAY, CHARDONNET PINOT BLANC, PINOT BLANC CHARDONNET, plus PINOT GRIGIO (which is actually Pinot Gris). (F3) 121 famous appellations stored with slash-concatenated alias names (Hermitage / Ermitage / L'Hermitage / L'Ermitage, Porto / Port). (F4) French AOC names missing diacritics (Echezeaux should be Échézeaux, Saint-Emilion variants). (F5) Pauillac 1855 classification has 3 of 5 tier counts wrong (says 1 Premier Cru but names 3, claims 1 Troisième when Pauillac has 0). (F6) grapes.name uses VIVC cépage+suffix form (CHARDONNAY BLANC, MERLOT NOIR, TEMPRANILLO TINTO) causing cascade issues. (F7) 921 grape-synonym primary-name collisions confirmed (re-ran S2.1 F7 with higher precision). (F8) S2.3 F7 CORRECTION: GARRO is a real VIVC grape #7326, not invented — error is in wine_grapes linkage, not grapes table. (F9) established_year poisoned with fake 1973 default on 240 FR + 105 IT appellations (Chambertin actual 1936, Barolo DOC 1966, Champagne 1936). (F10) classification_level dominated by German einzellage — only 2 rows tagged grand_cru, zero tagged docg/doc/ava/cru_classe. (F11) appellation_rules JSONB has no stable schema — Petit Chablis uses {Chardonnay:100} while Chambertin uses {principal:Pinot Noir}. (F18) Hunter Valley linked to Basalt in appellation_soils, likely reinforcing S2.3 F14 volcanic confabulation. Sprint 3 grape-repair workstream refined to 5-step sequence (3a grapes.name cleanup → 3b synonym collision resolution + F2 synonym delete → 3c varietal_categories fix → 3d wine_grapes resolver re-run → 3e rules JSONB backfill). No scope-breakers.

sessions.name: Code expert audit
sessions.notes: Sprint 2 Session 5. 32 findings in findings/findings_code.md: 9 P0, 14 P1, 7 P2, 2 P3. Opus inline + MCP edge function reads + SQL verification queries. $0 actual spend. Headline: (F1) describe-chemical edge function is dead code, deployed ACTIVE with verify_jwt=false, uses shared ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, has zero wine logic — unauthenticated credit-burn risk, delete; (F2) Code root cause of S2.3 F2 Chardonnay/Pinot Blanc identified — batch_pipeline._match_ttb_to_wine collapses 4 grape-specific COLAs (Chardonnay/Cab/Shiraz/Shiraz) onto 1 canonical wine for ~2,700 wines, compounded by ttb_grape_promote's DISTINCT ON arbitrary pick (F17); resolver in pipeline/lib/resolve.py is correct, bug is upstream dedup; (F3) relink_staging_to_current.py STAGING_TABLES_WINE lists only 1 of 30 staging tables — code-level cause of S2.2 F1 286K dangling wine_id pointers; (F4) enrich-wine edge function reads grapes.name (VIVC) not grapes.display_name — every Grade B prompt sees 'CHARDONNAY BLANC' not 'Chardonnay'; (F5) 3 Anthropic model IDs coexist without central config (haiku-4-5, sonnet-4, sonnet-4-6); (F11) 4+ duplicate grape lookup implementations across batch_pipeline/haiku_grape_extract/grape_from_name; (F18) lwin_long_tail.py inserts wines without display_name — 50,908 wines affected, biasing S2.3 F2 sample; (F24, F31) no supabase/migrations/ directory, edge function source not in git. Sprint 3 backlog: +23 items (9 P0 + 14 P1). Refined grape-repair workstream (3a-3e) extended with 3c.5 (fix multi-COLA collapse), 3c.6 (fix DISTINCT ON), 3c.7 (consolidate resolvers). Pre-Sprint-3 hygiene: delete describe-chemical, vendor enrich-wine source, centralize model IDs (~30 min combined).
